The '''''Dynasty''''' was a modified [[YT-1210 light freighter/Legends|YT-1210 light freighter]] that was owned and operated by [[Axtor Bridgeman]]. It boasted a faster [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], both main and backup, as well as two [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launchers]]. The ''Dynasty'' was also 7 meters longer than a stock YT-1210. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Axtor and his ship was operating in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].
